exposure: Women who underwent hysteroscopic electrocauterization vs. hysteroscopy-assisted transvaginal repair
cohort: 63 patients with cesarean scar defect (CSD) who desired future pregnancy
finding: Compared to hysteroscopic electrocauterization, hysteroscopy-assisted transvaginal repair of CSD was associated with greater myometrial thickness at 6 months and a higher rate of full-term live birth.
